@Vinnie Ω , to make it easy.

1. Go to ⁠2│verify-your-asset and then type: /verify add 
2. Press enter 
3. In the command line you will be prompted for your wallet address. 
4. Paste in your wallet address that holds the Cornucopias NFT. 
5. Press enter again. 
6. Hazel bot will ask you to send an amount of ADA. 
7. Copy this EXACT amount. 
8. Head over to your wallet that holds your NFTS and send to yourself the amount of ADA you've copied from the bot prompt. 
9. Once the transaction has been logged, hazel bot will state that you have been successfully verified. 
10. Wait for roles to drop. 

Bonus: IF you've used this bot to verify on other servers, you still need to run the /verify add command, but you do not need to send the ADA. After you've run the command the bot will say that you have been verified. After you see this, wait for the roles to drop. (edited)

Collateral is used in Smart Contract Transactions. For a smart contract to run it's scripts it needs to run the CPU of the validator Node. If the Smart Contract is good, and transaction triggers, the CPU usage is covered in the txs fee. If there's an issue with the script and the transaction does not trigger the CPU was used to read the script, but no fee to cover the usage. That's where the collateral comes in. To pay for those rare failures.

The tx fee will be less than .25ADA outbound. Then there will be an Inbound TX fee (about the same amount) when the NFT is sent.

So you send 18ADA (and are charged a tx fee)
you get back your NFT plus the balance of that 3ADA minus the tx fee to send it to you.

To have a working Farm the land owner needs to build up their facilities to a minimum level before the land can be farmed and other players can be invited to tend the land. The more facilities a landowner has on their property, the more attractive to other players their property becomes, as they will be able to offer services/raw goods that other competing farms may not yet offer. These services can be leveled up to increase productivity and crop yield.
It is the land owners decision whether their facilities will be used by other players. Allowing other players to help tend their land will bring the land owner additional rewards that they could not achieve by farming alone.

Disclosure first, I’m a game developer and I tried to put these as objectively as possible, in order to open the eyes of other people, as well, on why Cornucopias might be THE BEST metaverse out there. Enjoy!

Posting this here because, many might not realize, but one thing is to BUILD a metaverse, and a whole other MONSTER of a thing is for others to PLAY it.

All metaverses rely on the fact that sometime, MANY people will play their game, but these "many people" are the CASUAL GAMERS.

To get the CASUAL players to play a normal game, let alone a metaverse-crypto game, there must be met a few key aspects:

- user-friendliness: the onboarding process to a metaverse game MUST be easy, because the casual player has no knowledge whatsoever of blockchains/crypto etc
-  familiarity: in order to get someone external to play a game, that did not invested in it and has no current incentive to play, the game must feel familiar, offer an easy experience, in order to make the experience enjoyable and NOT feel like a task to learn how to play the game
- free stuff: casual gamers are greedy. They will pirate a game that costs 5$ only to avoid paying these to the App Store. ABSOLUTELY NO metaverse or crypto game will attract ANY player if it costs player to START play the game. NO ONE will pay immense sums of money to start playing a game. The game must offer as many utilities and as many thing to do for a player that spends nothing (free2play), and let him EARN stuff/money without having to invest anything



With that said, here are some of the key aspects that put, at least in my opinion, Cornucopias ahead of the herd when it comes to metaverse games:

- EVERYTHING is accessible by free 2 play. You can pay for NOTHING to make use of everything the game has to offer.
- You wanna race with other people's Bubblejetts/Javelins? you can rent them and pay the owner back from your race rewards, NOT before the race (that’s what I heard, at least)
- You wanna rent land? You can do the same as with the race vehicles
- You wanna have your own home? You have flying bubbles in which you can build anything you want. ALL small flying domes are free, and you can pay if you want a bigger dome.
- They will have Build 2 earn = you build a custom dome, do it as you want, and then can mint it and sell it. You can do that as many times as you want with your FREE domes, so you basically can earn money from NOTHING
- Sims-like building mechanics, that allow you to build your house and anything on your lands just like Sims/Fortnite, without having to 3D model in external software, like Pavia
- Unlike EVERY OTHER metaverse, all players houses are in AIR/FLYING, and you won't have to go through neighbors, empty lands and you won't fear of how the world might look like
- Imagine if 40% of Pavia (as an example) holders hold land just to flip, these lands will be empty, so, as a Pavia player, you will basically walk through a ton of empty lands
- Their team is fully doxxed and they have plenty of experience in the needed domains to pull a game like this
- They had external funding so they do not rely completely on NFT collections profit (at least up until now)
- Examples for the above point: they only took profit from 1 out of 5 mints, up until now, which is the Bubblejetts. They gave the Javelins (1.2m ada worth), OG Bubblejetts for free and the profit from2 Tree mints go 100% to Veritree for tree planting
